publication_policy: Build and verify locally, then upload identical bytes

phases.name: Baseline and inventory
gates: Record Git source revision
Inspect actual Supabase metadata read-only
Preserve installer modes 1-10 and mixed-role safeguards
No option 11

phases.name: Parser and API corrections
gates: Exact sealed embedded pack compatibility
Reject changed protected pack definitions
Consistent catalog and runtime inventory
Workspace requires nonempty independently reviewed expected output
Actionable HTTP status and request ID

phases.name: Versioned backup restore and sync
gates: Exact snapshot and export hash
Separate operator approval
Stale and tampered proposal rejection
Pre-restore snapshot and revision history retained
Interrupted restore and restart recovery
Exact controller materialization and client acknowledgement
No credential or unrelated raw history inclusion

phases.name: AI guidance and revision evidence
gates: Ground route labels in real navigation
Validate selected operation identifiers
Versioned guidance context and evaluation metadata
Provider invalid output and failure fallback
No model-training claim or stored provider secrets

phases.name: Qualification and stress
gates: User SMTP sample and header variants
Preserve flat final JSON and dynamic named keys
Malformed input quarantine and no data loss
Concurrent parser and API runs
Full Linux Go suite, vet, selected race and KV fuzz
Browser navigation and lifecycle controls
Service restart, rollout, rollback and exact acknowledgements
List tests and limits honestly

phases.name: Build and release
gates: Compiled runtime identity matches RPM release
Deterministic RPM and Web assets
Fresh archive extraction with LF checksums and executable modes
Actual controller and client installers
Mixed legacy role upgrade and preserved service enablement
GitHub asset digests match local checksums

limitations: Finite tests do not prove every possible log or environment
Stored published state is not a client application acknowledgement
Live AWS and real AI provider checks require reachable configured services
Do not hide failing or unexecuted checks
